Reproduce:   native/kernel/tests/fixtures/osc_receipt/make-receipts.sh --check <omega checkout at the commit above>
             rebuilds everything in a temporary directory and requires byte-identical files (Ed25519 is
             deterministic). expected.txt records, per case, checker2's own `receipt verify` verdict under the
